title: Azusawa Kohane — Smile Hued By Dusk〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Nice one, Miku! You really kicked it up a notch there!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also still have a few tricks left up my sleeve...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Thanks for agreeing to practice with me, Miku!
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you as well, Kohane.
That was really fun. For a second there, it felt like an actual event.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Especially the part where we sang back and forth together. You sang with so much energy that you got me just as fired up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! You also kept producing so much energy that I didn't want to let you hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way Miku sings seems to touch me so profoundly.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Actually, it's more than just her singing. It's her advice too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've lost count of all the times she's helped me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kohane...?
Are you feeling tired? Did you go a little overboard?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, no. I'm fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just remembered that I heard your voice while we were all trapped in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My voice? What did I say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You asked, “What do you think your true feelings are, Kohane?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was something you said when I still wasn't completely sure if I wanted to keep singing with An.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I remember now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, we did our best to try and wake you all up. Did you hear anything we said?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane! Kohane, can you hear me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's going on?! None of them are responding!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those black fragments must be behind all this. They took a different form than normal, but they're definitely fragments of feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, we need to chase after them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Chase after them?
But they're right here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, only their minds seem to have been sent over to the SEKAI of these fragments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If that's true, then we should also be able to send our minds into that SEKAI by touching these fragments!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm a little scared, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Here goes nothing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh?! What happened...?
Why weren't we sent over?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Settle down, you two.
I have a feeling that those fragments aren't like the ones we've encountered in the past.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what are we supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All we can do is believe in them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're right here. Please come back to us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
An! Can you hear me?
I'm right here! Please come back!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Akito! Toya!
I'm gonna keep calling your names until you guys all return! If you think I'm obnoxious, then come back fast!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's okay. I know they'll all be back with us soon!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because we're all right here with them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right! So, let's do as Miku says and maintain our faith.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You all called our names until we finally managed to wake back up...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I do remember...!
I did hear your voice, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But only just barely.
And I couldn't remember who was talking while I was stuck in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
But you did hear my voice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we were right to keep calling out your names.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Standing here right now and getting to sing with everyone is thanks to you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You gave me just the push I needed when I was ready to fall apart.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome.
